mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% MoM and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 0.5% QoQ, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy in a strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 4%.
